entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... uhm, yes. I bought some cycling shoes a while ago, and I think I need to return them. I was looking on your website and it's all very confusing. I don't really understand what to do.
I can certainly help you look into a return. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I'm not sure. They just don't feel right. I wore them on a couple of rides and I got terrible blisters on my heels. And I could never get the cleats to feel secure. It's all just been a bad experience. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear that the cycling shoes caused blisters and that you had trouble with the cleats. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order and check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, I see your order here. It looks like it was delivered 51 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you so much.

Of course. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Just package the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's perfect. Thank you, Isaac. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
